conditions.cache: OS cache uncontrolled, warmed by freezing and prior trials; no forced GC; each variant uses a new process and new DB
conditions.trials: Three warmup pairs excluded, then ten alternating AB/BA pairs per dataset unless CLI overrides; each initial build supplies the identical pre-append state for that trial
conditions.timing: Product StageProfiler refresh through COMMIT/optimize; queries outside refresh; copy, process startup, DB open/migration, empty rollup activation, append, checks and source restoration excluded
conditions.queries: All pages and total group counts, provider basis, full frozen input with no date boundaries, excludeEmptyUsage=true, unknownTime=include, Asia/Seoul; first post-refresh query per grouping; metadata and eligibility recorded
conditions.instrumentation: Existing StageProfiler and logical source read wrappers; B pool submission counts; worker file stats are not intercepted; overhead not separately calibrated
conditions.residual: Stage minus nested logical preparation wait; B tasks execute ahead in parallel, so residual is coordinator overhead rather than worker CPU time
conditions.exclusions: UI, extension-host IPC, quota, heap/GC peak, adversarial error/cancellation/rewrite scenarios and independent real-log parser oracle not measured; source-worker IPC is included

correctness.independentRealDataParserOracle: not performed; synthetic totals checked against generator
